protocol_if_compatible: Freeze the v2 temporal bundle and a manifest first; score a registered cohort once; never calibrate or choose thresholds on it. If no compatible labels exist, external validation stays blocked and is reported as such.
labels_never_inferred: Missing labels are not filled from another model or from play outcomes.
